acceptedAnswer.text: We scope it with a free front-door audit before we quote. If the phone is the leak, start with the 24/7 AI Receptionist at $299 a month. If you want the site, the listing and the phone run for you, Front Door. If your site needs replacing, a Standard or Premium build. If your front door is already fine, we say so and you owe nothing.
The first 3 paying Front Door clients pay $450 a month for their first 6 months, then $900 a month. It is written into the client agreement, and it ends when the 3 spots are taken.

Month to month. Cancel with 30 days written notice. Deposits are non-refundable once work begins; unused prepaid months are refunded. Managed services pause at day 14 unpaid; your site stays up at least 60 days. You own your domain, your listing, your content and your data at all times.
